edition: O. V. Belegradek, Model Theory of Unitriangular Groups, AMS Translations (2) 195 (1999), 1–116
digest_scope: Sorted numbered content/*.typ files, filename followed by NUL and UTF-8 bytes

lean.scope: Associativity and unit of a central extension with a trivial action; cocycle identity and normalization of coboundaries. A is an additive commutative group and B is any group.
lean.limitations: Does not prove the classification of extensions or the quasi-unitriangular representation and model-theoretic classification theorems.

sage.scope: Integer polynomial identities for degrees 3 and 4 with g_i(x,y)=lambda_i*x*y: twisted multiplication, associativity, inverse, superdiagonal decomposition, the printed UT4 product, and the UT4(Z) counterexample to the cocycle pullback on p.20.
sage.limitations: The polynomial identities specialize to commutative rings for this cocycle family. The computation does not cover noncommutative rings, arbitrary cocycles, or all matrix degrees.

literature.comparison: The factor set is defined on the quotient by the central kernel; it need not descend to the first superdiagonal quotient.
Interpretations by definable quotients preserve the distinct finite scalar tags in the corrected bimodule interpretation.

overall_limitations: The formal and polynomial checks cover only the specified passages. Other corrections are justified individually in corrections.json; the complete article has not been formalized.
